summary: xAI launched a free Grok add-in for Microsoft Excel (and Word/PowerPoint) that lets users ask questions about spreadsheet data, write formulas from natural-language descriptions, and pull context from connected email and file services.

practices.reason: A new consumer-facing Microsoft 365 add-in and connector surface exists, but it creates no engineering work for teams building on the API.
practices.quote: Grok for Excel is a free Microsoft 365 add-in. Add it from the Microsoft Marketplace , and work directly with Grok in your workbooks.
